captions.detailed: This 3D model is a cylindrical film scanner adapter and spacing tube. It features a long, hollow main body with a uniform outer diameter and a circular inner channel. At one end, there is an integrated lens mount consisting of three internal helical-style bayonet tabs, while the opposite end contains a flat circular plate with a small central hole for negative scanning.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric film scanner adapter tube in OpenSCAD. The design should include a main hollow spacing tube of adjustable length, a bottom face with a small central circular aperture, and a bayonet mount at the top consisting of three helical tabs for attaching to a camera lens.
captions.factory: The script constructs three main components: a negative face, a hollow tube, and a bayonet mount. The negative face is built using a difference of two cylinders to create a bottom plate with a central hole. The main body is a spacing tube created by differencing two concentric cylinders. The bayonet mount is composed of three identical tabs spaced 120 degrees apart; each tab is generated using an intersection of a rotated, extruded circle (creating a helical segment) and a cube to limit its angular span.
